name: Sierra
summary: Platform for building conversational AI agents that handle customer experience for businesses.
description: Sierra helps companies build AI agents that talk with their customers to resolve issues and complete tasks. Its recent announcements include a Personal Agent Protocol, Tandem Voice and new models. Customer stories cover several industries. Access is through sales; no public prices are listed. It is aimed at large consumer-facing companies. The company holds an annual Sierra Summit where it presents product updates.
